relations: A tabletop ablation could test which coordination conditions the Tiger Team model actually depends on.
Una ablación social no reproduce una prueba formal de principios EA. No retirar gobernanza real ni concluir necesidad universal a partir de un juego.
Task simulations could vary integration, data quality and expert support separately to examine which assumptions drive a human-work counterfactual.
Una ablación sintética no identifica por sí sola el efecto causal de una transformación empresarial real.
The complementary field layers suggest an ablation plan: remove or replace one mechanism at a time and examine which operating obligations cease to hold.
Las ablaciones son propuestas de evaluación; no deben ejecutarse retirando controles de una operación crítica en vivo.
Relative logical independence, a fixture ablation and an implementation effect answer different questions and should retain separate evidence labels.
No se deduce minimalidad universal ni independencia estadística de controles.
Matched public-view counterworlds can test whether a reported acquisition benefit comes from new evidence rather than accidental fixture-label leakage.
La fuga es un confusor para políticas futuras; la fuente no afirma que los brazos fijos existentes la exploten.
For a complementary reading, see [Ablation, sufficiency and bounded extensibility](https://tegrity.ai/when-the-controls-work-annex-6-ablation-sufficiency-and-extensibility/).
